title: Aegon's Landing
description: Aegon Targaryen and his sisters land at the mouth of the Blackwater Rush with their three dragons.

title: The Field of Fire
description: All three Targaryen dragons burn the combined armies of the Rock and the Reach. Four thousand men perish in the flames.

title: Aegon's Coronation
description: Aegon I Targaryen is crowned the first King of the Six Kingdoms at the Starry Sept of Oldtown.

title: Dorne refuses to kneel
description: Rhaenys Targaryen and Meraxes are shot down over Dorne. Rhaenys is captured and dies in captivity.

title: Death of Aegon I
description: Aegon the Conqueror dies at Dragonstone. Aenys I inherits the throne.

title: Dance of the Dragons begins
description: Civil war erupts between Rhaenyra Targaryen and her half-brother Aegon II over the Iron Throne.

title: The Storming of the Dragonpit
description: A mob storms the Dragonpit in King's Landing, killing several dragons including Syrax.

title: Dance of the Dragons ends
description: Both Aegon II and Rhaenyra die. The war ends with House Targaryen severely weakened and their dragons nearly extinct.

title: Death of King Robert
description: King Robert Baratheon dies from a hunting wound. Joffrey Baratheon ascends the Iron Throne.

title: Birth of the Dragons
description: Daenerys Targaryen hatches three dragon eggs on Drogo's funeral pyre. Dragons return to the world for the first time in over a century.

title: The Long Night returns
description: The Army of the Dead breaches the Wall. The Great War begins.

title: Battle of Winterfell
description: The living face the dead at Winterfell. Arya Stark kills the Night King, ending the Long Night.
